mechanism: Diltiazem may reduce renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, increasing amikacin accumulation and nephrotoxicity risk; amikacin is also nephrotoxic and ototoxic, compounding renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and amikacin levels closely; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on renal function.
